releases.label: Update
releases.title: Daily Mass, People & Places, Clause view and the Passage Guide
changes: New Mass tab: today's Mass every day. Choose the Novus Ordo (readings for the General Roman, Australian, Canadian, English & Welsh, Irish or US calendar, in your chosen translation) or the 1962 Latin Mass (full propers in English and Latin). Each day links to the Fathers on its Gospel.
New Guide tab in Study: everything Patristica has on a verse on one screen.
New People tab in Study: every named person and place in the Bible, deuterocanon included, with their references, family and a map pin.
New Clause tab in Study: the sentence structure of the Greek and Hebrew text, with 287 disputed constructions showing each possible reading and which Church Fathers held it.
New translation: the Persian Old Version (فارسی, 1895), read right to left. Download it in Library.
NASB: the small asterisks in the text (common in Mark) can now be tapped. They mark a Greek present-tense verb translated as past tense.
Optional downloads in Library (Reference): People & Places and the Clause View trees, for offline use.

releases.label: Update
releases.title: NASB and NKJV
changes: Three new translations: the New American Standard Bible (1995 and 2020 editions) and the New King James Version, provided by API.Bible.
They load online through Patristica's own server, like the ESV, and work in the main reader. If the server is busy, the chapter is shown in the KJV instead.
See the updated privacy policy for how these chapters are fetched.

releases.label: Update
releases.title: Gospel parallels, deeper word study, and the ESV for everyone
changes: The ESV no longer needs your own API key. Without one, chapters are requested through Patristica's own server, which counts requests by IP address in temporary memory to stay within Crossway's limits and keeps no record of what you read. See the updated privacy policy for details.
New Parallels tab in Study: see where the other Gospels tell the same passage, using the ancient Eusebian Canons.
Word study now shows meanings from the UBS Greek and Hebrew dictionaries, marks the sense used in the verse where known, and suggests related words.
Abbott-Smith's Greek lexicon added alongside Thayer. Both additions work online, or offline with the Lexicons pack.
Doctrine tab rebuilt with 133 hand-picked passages from the Church Fathers, with dissenting voices labelled and a revised history of icons.
New Deuterocanon Text setting, with the World English Bible Catholic as the default.

releases.title: Catholic canon and the Greek deuterocanon
changes: New Canon setting: choose Catholic (73 books) or Protestant. The Catholic canon places the deuterocanon in the Old Testament, with Susanna and Bel as Daniel 13 and 14.
World English Bible Catholic added, a public domain translation with all 73 books.
Word study now shows Septuagint Greek for the deuterocanon, and labels Aramaic passages.
Parallel and split view now work with downloaded translations.
World English Bible repaired: 147 missing verses restored, and the words of Christ now appear in red.
3 and 4 Maccabees are now in English.
New Aquinas tab: the Catena Aurea verse by verse, the Summa and Contra Gentiles, and a Thomist primer.

releases.title: Commentary everywhere
changes: Church Fathers commentary expanded to 60,376 entries from 55 fathers, drawn from their own scripture citations.
Commentary now loads without any download, and can be saved offline as a pack from Library → Downloads.
The app itself is much smaller: the bundled database dropped from 307 MB to 165 MB.
Hand-picked and Legacy commentary are now separate collections you switch between.

releases.title: Patristic commentary rebuilt, and ESV
changes: Verse-by-verse commentary rebuilt from the fathers' own citations, replacing the previous dataset.
Daily reading notifications.
Morphology parsing and display fixes, including Berean Standard Bible Psalms.
Fixed verses failing to load on a cold start.
ESV translation support — bring your own free Crossway API key from Settings.

releases.title: Reading plans and the home-screen widget
changes: Reading plans with progress tracking.
Android home-screen widget.
Early church study features: councils, creeds, canon formation, persecutions, and a geographic map of the fathers.
Greek Old Testament word study now works without downloading a pack.
Startup translation setting, and search now routes correctly to downloaded packs.

releases.title: Downloadable content packs
changes: Content pack system: 50+ optional downloads for translations, apocrypha, early Christian texts, and original-language sources.
Redesigned Downloads tab with grouping, bulk removal, and download-all.
Cross-references can now be sorted in biblical order.
KJV+ Strong's improvements and numerous fixes.

releases.title: Study tools
changes: Split passage view and focus mode.
Space saver display option.
Strong's translation variants modal.
Schisms panel, improved search ranking, and a skippable onboarding tour.
Concordance accuracy improvements.

releases.title: Original languages and red letters
changes: Red letter text for the words of Christ.
Greek and Hebrew search.
Parallel translations and parallel Strong's.
Font family picker and per-scope text settings.
Church fathers commentary with the map panel.

releases.title: Notes, cross-references and history
changes: Per-verse notes, plus a Notes tab listing them in biblical order.
Cross-references tab and verse sharing.
Reading history.
Historical tab in the Study screen.
Performance improvements across the main screens.
